figures.finding: From 2026 a private-sector (non-oil, non-government) employee's monthly taxable income is taxed at 3% up to AZN 2,500, AZN 75 plus 10% of the excess to AZN 8,000, and AZN 625 plus 14% above (5% and 7% in the first band in 2027 and 2028); oil, gas and government employees pay 14% to AZN 2,500 and AZN 350 plus 25% above; there is no regional layer.
figures.applies: Employment income of residents; a resident is taxed on worldwide income; the self-employed (independent entrepreneur) rate is not covered by the source read

sources.said: From January 1, 2026 to January 1, 2027 Up to 2,500 Azerbaijani manats (AZN) 3% From 2500 AZN to 8000 AZN 75 AZN + 10% of the amount exceeding AZN 2,500 Above AZN 8,000 625 AZN + 14% of the amount exceeding AZN 8,000 From January 1, 2027 to January 1, 2028 Up to 2,500 Azerbaijani manats (AZN) 5%
From January 1, 2028 Up to 2,500 Azerbaijani manats (AZN) 7%
Taxable monthly income Tax rate Up to AZN 2,500 14% Above AZN 2,500 AZN 350 + 25% of the amount exceeding AZN 2,500
Persons actually staying in the territory of Azerbaijan for more than 182 days during a calendar year are considered resident.

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; a return is due by 31 March of the next year from anyone with income not taxed at source, and tax withheld from pay is remitted on the day of payment.

value.entrepreneurAdvances: 15th day of the month after each quarter

sources.said: The following persons are liable for the filing of the annual PIT return to the tax authorities no later than 31 March of the following year: Residents having taxable income that was not taxed at source or deriving income outside of Azerbaijan.
Employers should transfer the withheld taxes on the same day of payment of income to employees.

figures.finding: From 2026 a private-sector employee pays social insurance of 3% to AZN 200 then 10% above, and the employer 22% to AZN 200, 15% to AZN 8,000 and 11% above; each also pays 0.5% unemployment insurance and medical insurance of 2% to AZN 2,500 and 0.5% above; foreign employees pay the same; entrepreneurs' rates vary by activity and region.
figures.applies: Employment income, private non-oil sector, from 2026

sources.said: Up to AZN 200 3% 22% From AZN 200 to AZN 8,000 AZN 6 + 10% for the amount between AZN 200 and AZN 8,000 AZN 44 + 15% for the amount between AZN 200 and AZN 8,000 Above AZN 8,000 AZN 786 + 10% for the amount above AZN 8,000 AZN 1214 + 11% for the amount above AZN 8,000

All foreign employees are subject to social security contributions at these rates, except persons with diplomatic status and expatriate employees working under PSAs. Entrepreneurs who are physical persons are liable to social security contributions at rates that vary depending on the type of activities and region of operation of such entrepreneurs.
each employer and employee will bear 0.5% UIC assessed on the gross monthly salary.
Non-oil & gas / non-government (Private Sector) Up to AZN 2,500 2% 2% 4% Portion above AZN 2,500 0.50% 0.50% 1%

figures.finding: The employer withholds income tax monthly at the rates above; a payer of a fee to an individual not registered as an independent entrepreneur withholds at the monthly income tax rates; royalties bear 14% at source.

value.unregisteredFreelancer: monthly income tax rates (source states 14% to 25%)

sources.said: Payments for goods or services provided by physical persons not registered as independent entrepreneurs (i.e. having no Tax ID): at monthly income tax rates (14% to 25%).
Lease payments for movable and immovable property, and royalties: 14%.

figures.finding: A non-resident performer, writer or director without a permanent establishment has 10% withheld from Azerbaijani-source income (the 'other income' rate; royalties 14%); income paid by a non-resident employer not through a permanent establishment is exempt.

value.final: withholding mechanism (a return is required only where not taxed by withholding)
value.exempt: pay from a non-resident employer not borne by an Azerbaijani PE

sources.said: Taxes deducted from incomes of non-resident physical persons not attributed to a PE (base) in Azerbaijan: Leasing or insurance payments under risk insurance or reinsurance agreements: 4%. Telecommunication or international transport services: 6%. Other income: 10%.
Non-resident’s income paid by an employer who is a non-resident of Azerbaijan, or on the employer’s behalf, which is not paid by a PE of such a non-resident.
Non-residents having taxable Azeri-source income not taxed in Azerbaijan through the withholding mechanism.

figures.finding: Royalties are taxed at source at 14% (resident payee) under the Tax Code as summarised; no other special regime for authors was found.

sources.said: Royalties: 14%.

figures.finding: VAT is 18%; registration is mandatory once taxable transactions exceed AZN 200,000 in any month of a consecutive 12-month period (or a single contract exceeds AZN 200,000).

sources.said: The standard rate of VAT is 18%.
If the volume of taxable transactions exceeds 200,000 manat in any month of a consecutive 12-month period, it shall take effect on the first day of the following month
